name: Cooler Master MasterKeys (V1)
description: Per-key lighting of the Cooler Master MasterKeys Pro S, Pro L and Pro L White (V1 protocol), with the ANSI, ISO or JIS key table the keyboard's firmware string picks. Adapted from OpenRGB's CMKeyboardV1Controller (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. The profile save and profile / effect writes are never sent; shutdown hands the lights back to the keyboard's firmware. The V2-protocol keyboards (SK6xx, CK5xx, MK730, MK750) are held back. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/coolermaster-masterkeys.md.
